mapper.select: SELECT id, title, descript, cover_image, image_keys, github, demo_url FROM project
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (title, descript, cover_image, image_keys, github, demo_url) VALUES (#{title}, #{descript}, #{coverImage}, #{imageKeys}, #{github}, #{demoUrl})
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET title = #{title}, descript = #{descript}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, image_keys = #{imageKeys}, github = #{github}, demo_url = #{demoUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
